title.es: Backoffice de Operaciones – Gestor de Inventario

description.en: Practice Spec Driven Development on the company monorepo: write EARS specs, plan, and tasks for an inventory manager where stock is derived from movements, then implement, verify, and absorb a mid-stream requirement change via the spec first.
